analyst.summary: Blue Jet Healthcare is a high-margin, low-debt specialty pharma ingredients supplier (contrast media intermediates and sweeteners) that saw revenue decline modestly over the past year after a period of stronger growth -- a real slowdown worth watching, though not one we can fully explain from public information, since this is a business with a concentrated global client base where order timing can swing reported growth. The company also just raised a large amount of fresh capital (Rs.800 crore) despite already carrying very little debt, presumably to fund expansion, which is worth tracking for how well that capital gets deployed.
